scope: Corollary 5.2 of the manuscript “Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four” (preprints/Brownian-continuum-random-tree-limits-of-finite-Fortuin-Kasteleyn-maps-above-four-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0d730ea9a40f1505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 18-19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: We have max v H(v) = OP( √ N), max v W(v) = OP( √ N), ∆N = oP( √ N), (5.4) 18 and max v |W(v) − νH(v)| = oP( √ N). (5.5)
